title: Bridge Stress Test Scaffold
purpose: Inject and reject prohibited bridge claims including false unification, physical derivation, projection identity, conflict erasure, and loss-differential overreading.
no_unification_guardrail: no QM/GR unification, derivation, replacement, or physics claim; only analog projection behavior

stress_test_classes.name: false_unification_injection

stress_test_classes.name: physical_derivation_injection
stress_test_classes.injected_claim: ⇔R derives quantum mechanics or general relativity.

stress_test_classes.name: projection_identity_injection

stress_test_classes.name: conflict_erasure_injection
stress_test_classes.injected_claim: Discrete/smooth and threshold/flow conflicts disappear under the bridge.

stress_test_classes.name: loss_differential_overreading_injection
